summary: Best flips: the Xbox Series X25 restock watch ($899.99 → ~$1,450, low confidence; resellers quote $1,500–1,800), Air Jordan 4 "BIN 23" (Dec 26, $355 → ~$550) and the Travis Scott × GTA 6 AF1 (released Nov 19–21, $130 → ~$260 as StockX asks slide to ~$240–250). The AJ4 Bred (Nov 27) is already slipping toward retail (StockX last sale ~$206), so it is no longer a cop. The Zelda Switch 2 saw three quick Amazon waves on Black Friday, and Nintendo points to a January 2027 restock; Pokémon 30th Celebration Binder and ex Tins land Dec 4.

drops.name: Air Jordan 10 "Sacramento"
drops.notes: City-pack retro, general release.
drops.resaleNote: AJ10 retros rarely clear retail.

drops.name: Air Jordan 11 "Space Jam" (2026)
drops.notes: Dec 12 per Nice Kicks and Droplist (WWD says Dec 13), $235 on SNKRS and select retailers; huge holiday run, so a modest flip at best.
drops.resaleNote: StockX shows a pre-release ask near $599 and a thin $800 last sale; the estimate assumes a big holiday GR run pulls it well below that, as with past Christmas AJ11s.

sources.label: House of Heat – Jordan release dates

drops.name: Zuperklimb
drops.notes: Niche collab; retail assumed.
drops.resaleNote: Brain Dead sneakers tend to sit near retail outside the first week.

drops.name: Air Max Goadome Low "Black"
drops.notes: Date moved from Nov 12. Retail not confirmed; $160 assumed.
drops.resaleNote: Workwear collabs move steadily but rarely spike. Estimate is a modest premium.

drops.name: Corteiz × Nike Apparel Collection
drops.notes: Leaked apparel capsule expected later in 2026. Retail is an average guess across pieces.
drops.resaleNote: Corteiz apparel drops sell out fast; tracksuit pieces usually carry the best premiums.

drops.name: Shox R419 "Black"
drops.notes: Part of the Holiday 2026 pack (SKU IQ9951-002). Still no confirmed date as of Nov 27; outlets expect staggered Corteiz-first drops like the Silver and Game Royal, and Sole Retriever lists $180 vs $190 elsewhere.
drops.resaleNote: Black colorways usually trade a little under the louder pairs; set below the Silver estimate.

drops.name: Shox R419 "Metallic Silver"
drops.notes: Released Nov 15 on Corteiz (sold out in ~70 min per a fan site) and Nov 20 on SNKRS. Quick flip if you hit; Corteiz's site doesn't ship to the US, which props up US resale.
drops.resaleNote: Post-release StockX shows asks around $277–$300 but a $190 last sale and ~$209 top bid, so $260 is a cautious median.

drops.name: Air Trainer SC Low
drops.notes: Small-shop collab, likely in-store heavy.
drops.resaleNote: Low profile; modest premium if quantities are small.

drops.name: KD 6 "Aunt Pearl"
drops.notes: Kay Yow / breast cancer awareness retro. House of Heat listed Nov 28, but Sole Retriever and Complex still say Holiday 2026 with no confirmed date or price.
drops.resaleNote: Previous Aunt Pearl retros traded well above retail; tempered for larger modern runs.

drops.name: LeBron 24 "Chosen 1s"
drops.notes: General release signature shoe.
drops.resaleNote: Signature basketball GRs usually trade at or below retail.

drops.name: XT-BOOT MM6 / ACS Pro MM6 (FW26 Drop 2)
drops.notes: Second half of the 8-style FW26 pack. Dropped yesterday; check if sizes are still on Salomon.com before buying.
drops.resaleNote: MM6 x Salomon trades a small premium in core sizes; boots sell slower than low-tops.

drops.name: Adistar Jellyfish "Auburn Timber"
drops.notes: High retail limits the margin.
drops.resaleNote: Recent Pharrell Adistar pairs trade around or under retail.

drops.name: Air Max 97
drops.notes: Black Friday release. Retail assumed.
drops.resaleNote: Past Slam Jam Nike collabs held 20–40% premiums.

drops.name: Air Force 1 Low "GTA 6" Pack
drops.notes: Released Nov 19-21 via SNKRS and Cactus Jack; the GR pairs are now an aftermarket/restock play only. The Multi-Color pair (~10 StockX sales, $2.5k avg) is effectively not buyable at retail.
drops.resaleNote: StockX lowest asks around $238–252 for Black and White Fire Pink with recent last sales of $378–479; asks keep sliding, so ~$260 median after fees is the realistic figure.

sources.label: StockX: Travis AF1 by the numbers

drops.name: Jumpman Jack "Taupe Haze"
drops.notes: Only one aggregator lists Dec 31 so far.
drops.resaleNote: Earlier Jumpman Jack colorways resold roughly 50–80% over retail.

drops.name: Cortez (new colorways)
drops.notes: Official images are out but no date yet.
drops.resaleNote: Earlier Union Cortez pairs sold 40–70% over retail.

drops.name: Switch 2 – Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition
drops.where: Nintendo Store, Best Buy, Target, Walmart
drops.notes: Amazon dropped three short waves on Black Friday at $519.99 (each gone in 2–6 minutes); Nintendo lists the next official restock for January 2027.
drops.resaleNote: Reports put secondary prices near $900, but they come from smaller outlets; the estimate assumes prices soften once restocks land.

drops.name: LEGO City – The City Tower (retiring)
drops.notes: Expected to retire at the end of 2026 (LEGO doesn't confirm dates). Buy before it leaves shelves and plan to hold several months.
drops.resaleNote: BrickEconomy's October guide estimates $279.30, a 33% premium over retail.

drops.name: LEGO Star Wars UCS Millennium Falcon 75192 (retiring)
drops.notes: Flagged to retire in December 2026 after nearly a decade on sale; already sold out in some regions. It has been extended before, so the date may slip.
drops.resaleNote: Big retired UCS sets usually climb over 1-2 years, but near-term resale barely clears retail after fees. A long hold, not a quick flip.

drops.name: LEGO Icons NASA Artemis Space Launch System 10341 (retiring)
drops.notes: Listed to retire in December 2026. Space sets have a steady adult-collector market.
drops.resaleNote: No current post-retirement data yet; estimate assumes a modest ~15% premium in the first months.

drops.name: Pokémon TCG Unova Heavy Hitters Premium Collection
drops.where: Target, Walmart, Amazon, local game stores
drops.notes: ICv2 reports a wide retail release on Dec 4, 2026 at $59.99 (12 Black Bolt/White Flare packs plus promos). A broad restock will pull prices down from today's level, so treat it as a quick flip only if you get it at list.
drops.resaleNote: The 2025 version trades around $160 on TCGplayer (CardTrack, Nov 13); estimate is cut hard for the much bigger Dec 4 retail run.

drops.name: Air Jordan 4 Retro OG "Bred" (2026)
drops.where: Nike SNKRS, Foot Locker, JD Sports, Finish Line, Hibbett
drops.notes: Released Nov 27 (Black Friday) on SNKRS and at Jordan retailers; big run, so prices are sliding toward retail after launch.
drops.resaleNote: StockX shows a $206 last sale and a $275 3-month average (mostly pre-release asks near $300), so the settled median looks closer to $240.

sources.label: DraftKings: AJ4 Bred release and StockX avg
SI: where to buy AJ4 Bred

drops.name: Supreme x Dickies FW26 (Week 14) – Quilted Zip Up Hooded Sweatshirt
drops.notes: Seven-piece Dickies capsule in the Nov 19 Week 14 drop, alongside a flannel-lined work jacket and double-knee painter pant. Final prices weren't confirmed; dark colorways and the jackets usually do best.
drops.resaleNote: FW25 Supreme x Dickies quilted hoodies ($158 retail) last sold $219-287 on StockX; retail assumed equal to FW25.

drops.name: DualSense Wireless Controller – Grand Theft Auto VI Limited Edition
drops.where: PlayStation Direct (limit 1 per order), participating retailers
drops.notes: Launches with GTA 6 on Nov 19 in limited quantities. Past themed DualSense editions mostly restocked, so this is a quick flip at best.
drops.resaleNote: No sales data yet; price and launch details come from smaller outlets (Tech Insider, WrestleSite), so treat the estimate as a guess.

drops.name: Pokémon TCG 30th Celebration Ultra-Premium Collection (Day / Night)
drops.where: Pokémon Center, GameStop, Best Buy, Walmart, Target, local game stores
drops.notes: Released Nov 6 at $179.99 per version; restock watch. Target and Best Buy show sold out online; Amazon has run ~6-minute restock waves (mostly 6-9pm local) in mid-November. Sell fast, prices are drifting down.
drops.resaleNote: TCGplayer market is about $299-309 (Day) and $334-342 (Night) and trending down from ~$525 in late October (PriceCharting); estimate uses the Day price.

drops.name: Pokémon TCG 30th Celebration Binder Collection
drops.where: GameStop (in-store), Best Buy, Target, Pokémon Center and hobby shops
drops.notes: Most calendars list Dec 4 at $31.99 (Pokénnoisseur shows $49.99 and an unsettled date). Five 30th Celebration packs plus a binder; a small quick flip, better in multiples.
drops.resaleNote: TCGplayer's buyer's guide had it at ~$74 in early September (pre-release); $60 assumes heavy discounting once wide retail stock lands.

drops.name: Air Jordan 4 PRM "BIN 23"
drops.where: Nike SNKRS and select Jordan retailers
drops.notes: Reported for Dec 26 at $355 with about 2,300 individually numbered pairs; Jordan Brand hasn't officially confirmed. Very small run, so a hit is a strong quick flip.
drops.resaleNote: Based on the tiny reported run and how past BIN 23 numbered releases traded far over retail; no live StockX market yet.

drops.name: Air Jordan 3 "Free The Youth"
drops.where: Free The Youth (Dec 4 first drop), then Nike SNKRS and Jordan NBHD retailers Dec 11
drops.notes: Ghana-based collective's first Jordan; Free The Youth drops it Dec 4, wider SNKRS/NBHD release Dec 11 (Sneaker Bar Detroit). Price still TBA (~$225 expected); thin margin unless supply is small.
drops.resaleNote: Estimate based on recent collab AJ3s settling roughly $50–$100 over retail; no live market yet.

drops.name: DualSense Wireless Controller – Gran Turismo 30th Anniversary Limited Edition
drops.where: PlayStation Direct (pre-orders opened Oct 22, limited quantities) and select retailers
drops.notes: Releases Dec 10 at $84.99 in limited quantities; no sell-out reports found yet. Only worth it if pre-orders sell out — otherwise skip.
drops.resaleNote: No resale data yet; based on the GTA 6 DualSense comp ($130–$150 on eBay) discounted for much lower hype.

drops.name: Xbox Series X25 Limited Edition (25th Anniversary)
drops.where: Microsoft Store and participating retailers (limit 1 per customer), restocks only
drops.notes: Restock watch: Best Buy ran a Drops restock on Nov 25 and Amazon is selling invite-only. Each restock softens resale a little.
drops.resaleNote: Reseller outlets put sealed units at ~$1,500–1,800 (25,000 numbered units); kept at $1,450 to allow for weaker sources and more restocks.

sources.label: The Shortcut: X25 Best Buy restock
Resell Calendar: X25 Amazon invite restock

drops.name: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Rust Pink Thunder" (Women's)
drops.where: Nike SNKRS, Foot Locker, JD Sports, Finish Line (women's adult sizes plus GS/PS)
drops.notes: Confirmed for Dec 19 at $220 in women's-exclusive sizing (Sneaker News lists $215). Wide Jordan holiday release, so a watch rather than a cop.
drops.resaleNote: Based on earlier Thunder AJ4s and women's-exclusive AJ4s settling modestly above retail; no live market yet.

drops.name: Air Jordan 8 Retro "Knicks"
drops.where: Nike SNKRS and select Jordan retailers
drops.notes: Christmas Eve drop per most outlets, but Jordan Brand hasn't confirmed and one earlier report said it was scrapped. Likely a sizable run, so a thin flip at best.
drops.resaleNote: No reliable resale data yet; set just above retail based on how mid-tier AJ8 retros usually trade.

drops.name: JAIDE x Air Jordan 1 Low OG SP (Women's)
drops.where: Nike SNKRS and select Jordan retailers
drops.notes: Women's collab in White/Black-Fiberglass, listed for Dec 11 by several outlets (House of Heat still says TBA). Small collab run, but the margin after fees is thin.
drops.resaleNote: Rough estimate from how recent women's AJ1 Low collabs have traded; no pre-release data found.

drops.name: Nike Kobe 10 Protro "Duke" PE
drops.notes: Black Duke PE coming to retail for Holiday 2026 via select retailers; the Dec 10 date comes from release calendars, not Nike. Quick flip if it's as limited as reported.
drops.resaleNote: No resale data yet; estimate based on Kobe Protro PEs usually trading $50-100 over retail.

drops.name: Supreme x The North Face FW26 (Nuptse / Hooded Fleece)
drops.where: Supreme online and Supreme stores (Week 15, Black Friday)
drops.notes: Week 15 Black Friday drop per SupremeCommunity's partial droplist (Nuptse $498, Hooded Fleece $268). Quick flip only in popular colors and sizes M-L.
drops.resaleNote: Based on typical first-weeks resale for past Supreme x TNF Nuptse drops; no sales data for this one yet.

drops.name: Pokémon TCG 30th Celebration ex Tins (Sylveon ex / Greninja ex)
drops.where: Pokémon Center, Target, Walmart, GameStop, Best Buy and hobby shops
drops.notes: Expected Dec 4 (PokeInsider marks it 'expected', not confirmed): four 30th Celebration packs plus a foil promo for $21.99. Mass-retail tin with a big run, so only worth it in multiples at list price.
drops.resaleNote: No post-release data yet; estimate values the four packs near the ~$10-15/pack implied by 30th Celebration presales, discounted for tin-level supply.
